unmatched_reported.note: Concrete trigger: a parent cancels a REQUESTED/ACCEPTED pack booking more than 24h ahead, and a session is restored that was never deducted.
Concrete trigger: a 502/504 or a 500 after Stripe captured the charge resets the idempotency key, so a retry can charge twice.

Concrete trigger: a pause scheduled to start in the future blocks booking and settlement right away because the check is only now < pausedUntil.
Concrete trigger: an ACCEPTED pack booking not in the pause cancellation list fails settlement with packPaused even if its session date is outside the pause.
